acquisition_method.evidence: Eluting peptides were analyzed in the mass spectrometer using data independ acquisition (DIA) mode.
experiment types: Gel-based experiment; Data-independent acquisition; Bottom-up proteomics

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins (10 µg) were run for 0.5 cm into an SDS-PAGE and the entire piece was cut out and digested using trypsin according to Shevchenko et al. (Shevchenko, Andrej, et al. "In-gel digestion for mass spectrometric characterization of proteins and proteomes." Nature protocols 1.6 (2006): 2856.) adapted to on a DigestPro MSi robotic system (INTAVIS Bioanalytical Instruments AG).

collision_energy.evidence: A full scan at 120k resolution (380-1400 m/z, 300% AGC target, 45 ms maxIT) was followed by 47 MS2 DIA windows covering the mass range from 400-1000 m/z with variable width (30k resolution, AGC target 1000%, maxIT 54 ms, with 1 m/z overlap, 28% HCD collision energy).

fragmentation_method.evidence: A full scan at 120k resolution (380-1400 m/z, 300% AGC target, 45 ms maxIT) was followed by 47 MS2 DIA windows covering the mass range from 400-1000 m/z with variable width (30k resolution, AGC target 1000%, maxIT 54 ms, with 1 m/z overlap, 28% HCD collision energy).

instrument.evidence: A LC-MS/MS analysis was carried out on an Ultimate 3000 UPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) directly connected to an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer for a total of 120 min.
